In Israel, patients with astrocytoma are offered a comprehensive approach to diagnosis and treatment based on the latest research and innovative technologies.

Diagnosis of astrocytoma

  1. MRI of the brain
    The main diagnostic method, establishing the position, size and structure of the tumour.
  2. CT of the brain
    May be used for additional imaging of the tumour and assessment of its effect on the surrounding structures.
  3. Biopsy
    Carried out to obtain a sample of tumour tissue, which is examined to determine the type of tumour and how malignant it is.
  4. Laboratory tests
    Include blood tests to assess general health and identify possible markers of inflammation or other changes linked to the tumour.
  5. Genetic testing
    May be recommended to identify specific mutations in the tumour cells, which can affect the choice of treatment.

Treatment of astrocytoma

  1. Surgery
    The primary and often most effective treatment, aimed at removing as much of the tumour as possible.
  2. Radiotherapy
    Used after surgery to destroy remaining tumour cells, particularly in high-grade astrocytomas.
  3. Chemotherapy
    Used in combination with other treatments to fight the tumour, particularly in aggressive forms of astrocytoma.
  4. Targeted therapy and immunotherapy
    The newest approaches to treating astrocytoma, directed at specific molecular targets and at stimulating the immune system to fight the cancer cells.

Why patients choose Israel

  • Advanced methods of diagnosis and treatment
    Access to the newest technologies and treatments, including minimally invasive surgery and personalised therapy.
  • A multidisciplinary approach
    Specialists from various fields of medicine work together to develop the best treatment plan for each patient.
  • Individual treatment
    Treatment programmes are adapted to each patient, taking account of every aspect of their health and the specific nature of the tumour.
  • Comprehensive support
    Psychological, social and rehabilitation support is provided at every stage of treatment.

Treatment of astrocytoma in Israel combines high medical expertise, access to innovative technologies and a deep understanding of patients' needs, which produces the most effective results and improves patients' quality of life.

fields.title: Atherosclerosis
fields.bodyHtml:
Atherosclerosis: advanced treatment in Israel

Atherosclerosis is a chronic condition marked by the formation of plaques in the arteries, which impairs the blood supply to the organs and tissues. In Israel, innovative approaches are used to treat atherosclerosis, aimed at slowing the progression of the disease and preventing complications.

Diagnosis of atherosclerosis:

  1. Laboratory tests
    Full blood count, cholesterol tests, lipid profile, markers of inflammation and other biochemical markers.
  2. Ultrasound examination of the vessels (Doppler)
    Assessment of the state of the arteries and of any atherosclerotic changes.
  3. Computed tomography (CT) and magnetic resonance imaging (MRI)
    Imaging of the arteries to identify narrowed sections and assess the plaques.
  4. Angiography
    An invasive investigation that establishes precisely how far the vessels are narrowed.

Methods of treating atherosclerosis:

  1. Drug treatment:
    • Statins and other lipid-lowering drugs to control cholesterol levels.
    • Antihypertensive drugs to control blood pressure.
    • Drugs that prevent blood clots, such as aspirin or other antiplatelet agents.
  2. Surgical treatment:
    • Angioplasty with stenting: widening the narrowed sections of the vessels and fitting a stent to keep them open.
    • Coronary artery bypass grafting: creating bypass routes for the blood around the narrowed sections of the coronary arteries.
    • Endarterectomy: surgical removal of atherosclerotic plaques from the arteries.
  3. Changes in lifestyle:
    • A balanced diet: low in saturated fat and cholesterol and rich in fruit, vegetables and whole grains.
    • Regular physical exercise: helps improve circulation and reduce weight.
    • Giving up smoking: smoking considerably increases the risk that atherosclerosis will progress.

Advantages of treatment in Israel:

  • A multidisciplinary approach: cardiologists, vascular surgeons and dietitians work together to create the best treatment strategy.
  • Personalised treatment: an individual treatment programme is chosen on the basis of thorough diagnosis and the particular condition of each patient.
  • Access to advanced technology: the use of the newest medical technologies and techniques in treating atherosclerosis.
  • A high standard of medical care: experienced specialists and medical staff providing high-quality treatment and support at every stage of treatment and recovery.
  • Treatment of atherosclerosis in Israel is aimed at actively improving the condition of the vessels, reducing the risk of cardiovascular complications and providing long-term prevention to maintain patients' health and quality of life.

fields.title: Optic nerve atrophy
fields.bodyHtml:
Optic nerve atrophy is a condition in which the nerve fibres of the optic nerve degenerate, leading to progressive loss of sight. The causes may include inherited disease, inflammation, injury, poisoning and other factors.

Diagnosis of optic nerve atrophy

The following methods are used in Israel to diagnose optic nerve atrophy accurately:

  1. Detailed review of the medical history: the doctor talks with the patient about their medical history, including symptoms, the events preceding the illness, previous conditions and treatment.
  2. Visual examination: the doctor examines the patient's eyes, looking for possible changes in the structure of the fundus, the diameter of the pupil and other signs of optic nerve atrophy.
  3. Measurement of vision: visual acuity is tested both with Snellen charts and with specialised optical instruments.
  4. Visual field testing: special tests such as perimetry may be used to assess the function of the optic nerve and establish whether the patient has any restriction of the visual field.
  5. Optical coherence tomography (OCT): a scan of the eye that produces high-quality images of the structures of the fundus, including the optic nerve and retina.
  6. Retinal angiography: where necessary, retinal angiography may be carried out to assess the blood supply to the eye and identify any conditions associated with optic nerve atrophy.
  7. Consultation with a neuro-optometrist or neuro-ophthalmologist: the patient discusses the results of all the investigations with a specialist, who provides the diagnosis and advice on further treatment and management.
  8. Explanation and treatment planning: on the basis of the diagnostic results the doctor explains to the patient the nature of the condition, its possible causes and the best treatment options. An individual management plan is drawn up, which may include drug treatment, rehabilitation or surgery.

Methods of treating optic nerve atrophy

Advanced methods of treating optic nerve atrophy are used in Israel:

  1. Drug therapy: includes medicines that improve the blood supply and metabolic processes in the optic nerve.
  2. Vitamin therapy: the use of B vitamins, antioxidants and neuroprotective agents to support the health of the nerve cells.
  3. Physiotherapy: methods such as magnetic therapy, ultrasound therapy and electrical stimulation help stimulate the regeneration of nerve fibres.
  4. Laser therapy: used to improve the blood supply and nutrition of the nerve tissue.
  5. Electrical stimulation: helps activate the remaining healthy nerve fibres.
  6. Surgical treatment: in rare cases this may be needed to remove the cause of the atrophy (decompression of the optic nerve, for example).

Advantages of treatment in Israel

  1. Highly qualified specialists: Israeli doctors have rich experience and international recognition in ophthalmology.
  2. Modern equipment: clinics are equipped with the newest diagnostic and treatment instruments, which ensures accuracy and effectiveness.
  3. An individual approach: every patient is given a personalised treatment plan that takes account of all aspects of their health.
  4. Interdisciplinary collaboration: doctors of various specialities work closely together to achieve the best treatment results.
  5. High standards of safety and quality: Israeli clinics adhere strictly to international protocols and standards of medical care.

Treatment of optic nerve atrophy in Israel gives patients access to highly qualified medical care, improves their quality of life and helps preserve their sight for many years.

fields.title: Autoimmune thyroiditis
fields.bodyHtml:
Autoimmune thyroiditis: advanced treatment in Israel

Autoimmune thyroiditis, also known as chronic lymphocytic thyroiditis or Hashimoto's disease, is the most common autoimmune condition of the thyroid gland. In this condition the immune system mistakenly attacks the tissue of the thyroid, which can lead to hypothyroidism — an underactive thyroid. Israel takes a comprehensive approach to diagnosing and treating autoimmune thyroiditis, drawing on the latest research and innovative techniques.

Diagnosis of autoimmune thyroiditis:

  1. Blood tests for thyroid hormones
    Levels of thyroid hormones (T3 and T4) and of thyroid-stimulating hormone (TSH) are measured to assess thyroid function. Antibodies to thyroid peroxidase (anti-TPO) and thyroglobulin are identified, which helps confirm the autoimmune nature of the condition.
  2. Ultrasound examination of the thyroid gland
    Allows the structure and size of the gland and the presence of nodules to be assessed.
  3. Fine needle biopsy (where necessary)
    Used to rule out cancer of the thyroid if suspicious nodules are found.

Treatment of autoimmune thyroiditis in Israel:

  1. Hormone replacement therapy
    with levothyroxine to make up the deficit of thyroid hormones.
  2. Individual adjustment of drug doses
    based on regular monitoring of the TSH level.
  3. Thyroidectomy
    Surgical removal of the thyroid gland or part of it may be recommended where drug treatment is ineffective, where the gland is considerably enlarged and presses on neighbouring structures, or where suspicious nodules are present. In Israel, thyroid operations are often performed using minimally invasive techniques, including laparoscopic methods.
  4. Treatment with iodine-containing preparations
    where there is iodine deficiency.
  5. Comprehensive support
    Consultations with a dietitian and psychological support to improve general health and help manage stress.

Advantages of treatment in Israel:

  • Highly qualified specialists
    Israeli doctors have considerable experience in diagnosing and treating autoimmune thyroid disease.
  • Advanced medical technology
    The use of modern equipment and techniques ensures accurate diagnosis and effective treatment.
  • An individual approach
    Attention to every patient and account taken of their particular circumstances and preferences when the treatment plan is drawn up.
  • Close collaboration between specialists
    Endocrinologists, surgeons, dietitians and psychologists work closely together to provide comprehensive care.

Treatment of autoimmune thyroiditis in Israel is aimed at controlling symptoms, normalising thyroid function and preventing complications, which allows patients to lead an active and healthy life.

fields.title: Azoospermia
fields.bodyHtml:
Azoospermia: advanced treatment in Israel

Azoospermia is the absence of sperm in the ejaculate and is one of the causes of male infertility. In Israel, modern methods are used to diagnose and treat azoospermia, giving many men hope of fatherhood.

Diagnosis of azoospermia:

  1. Repeat semen analysis
    Several semen analyses are recommended to confirm the diagnosis, since results can vary.
  2. Laboratory tests
    Blood tests for the hormones that regulate the work of the reproductive glands (testosterone, FSH, LH, prolactin) help establish the type of azoospermia (obstructive or non-obstructive).
  3. Genetic tests
    Carried out to identify chromosomal abnormalities or specific genetic mutations that may be the cause of azoospermia.
  4. Transrectal ultrasound
    Used to assess the state of the sperm ducts and detect possible obstruction.
  5. Testicular biopsy
    Carried out to obtain testicular tissue for examination under the microscope and to look for sperm.

The plan of investigation is drawn up individually and can take up to two days, after which the results are awaited and a detailed consultation with the doctor follows. For more information, contact our free adviser (we will review medical records from your own country if you have them).

Methods of treating azoospermia in Israel:

  1. Surgical treatment of obstructive azoospermia
    Includes operations to restore the patency of the sperm ducts, such as vasovasostomy or vasoepididymostomy.
  2. Treatment of non-obstructive azoospermia
    Aimed at stimulating sperm production with hormone therapy, where the cause of the condition allows.
  3. Assisted reproductive technologies
    Where sperm are found in the testis or epididymis, they can be used for fertilisation within IVF/ICSI programmes. Methods of retrieving sperm include TESE (testicular sperm extraction), TESA (testicular sperm aspiration) and others.
  4. Advice on the use of donor sperm
    Where sperm cannot be obtained, couples may consider using donor sperm to conceive.

Advantages of treatment in Israel:

  • A personalised approach: an individual treatment plan for every patient, depending on the cause of the azoospermia.
  • A multidisciplinary team: urologists, endocrinologists, geneticists and fertility specialists take part in treatment, ensuring a comprehensive approach.
  • Use of modern technology: Israel's leading clinics are equipped with the latest diagnostic and treatment equipment, which improves the chances of success.
  • A high level of expertise: Israeli specialists have international recognition in the treatment of male infertility and in introducing innovative techniques.

Treatment of azoospermia in Israel offers men advanced solutions aimed at making fatherhood possible despite difficult diagnoses, with comprehensive support at every stage of treatment.

fields.title: Barrett's oesophagus
fields.bodyHtml:
Barrett's oesophagus: advanced treatment in Israel

Barrett's oesophagus is a condition in which the normal cells lining the lower part of the oesophagus are replaced by cells not typical of that area. This can increase the risk of developing adenocarcinoma of the oesophagus. Modern methods of diagnosis and treatment are used in Israel to monitor the condition and prevent it progressing.

Diagnosis of Barrett's oesophagus:

  1. Endoscopy with biopsy
    The main diagnostic method, allowing the altered areas of the lining to be seen and tissue samples taken for histological analysis.
  2. Biopsy with radiofrequency ablation
    Used to remove or reduce the volume of abnormal tissue.
  3. Immunocytochemical studies
    Identification of molecular markers that may indicate an increased risk of progression to cancer.
  4. Chromoendoscopy
    The use of special dyes during endoscopy for better visualisation of abnormal cells.

Methods of treating Barrett's oesophagus:

  1. Radiofrequency ablation (RFA):
    • A minimally invasive procedure that uses radiofrequency waves to destroy the altered cells without damaging the surrounding tissue.
  2. Endoscopic mucosal resection (EMR):
    • Removal of abnormal areas of the lining of the oesophagus using specialised endoscopic equipment.
  3. Drug treatment:
    • Proton pump inhibitors to reduce the acidity of the stomach contents, which helps lessen irritation of the lining of the oesophagus and supports healing.
  4. Diet and lifestyle changes:
    • Changes in eating habits, including avoiding late meals and reducing the intake of fatty and spicy food and alcohol.
    • Maintaining a healthy weight and avoiding tight clothing.

Advantages of treatment in Israel:

  • A personalised approach to every patient: treatment based on individual characteristics and the stage of the condition.
  • Use of advanced technology: the introduction of the newest methods of diagnosis and treatment, which improves the chances of a good outcome.
  • Multidisciplinary medical teams: experienced gastroenterologists, surgeons and oncologists work together to ensure a comprehensive approach to treatment.
  • A high standard of medical care: excellent quality of medical services and attention to detail in patient care.
  • Education and rehabilitation: patients are given all the information they need about the condition and its treatment, along with advice on lifestyle changes to minimise the risk of recurrence.

Treatment of Barrett's oesophagus in Israel is aimed at minimising the risk of oesophageal cancer and improving patients' quality of life through accurate diagnosis, effective treatment and continuing medical follow-up.

fields.title: Basal cell carcinoma
fields.bodyHtml:
Basal cell carcinoma: advanced treatment in Israel

Basal cell carcinoma is the most common type of skin cancer. It grows slowly and rarely spreads, but without proper treatment it can cause considerable damage to the skin and the tissues beneath it. In Israel, patients with basal cell carcinoma are offered a wide range of modern methods of diagnosis and treatment, aimed at preserving as much healthy skin as possible and preventing recurrence.

Diagnosis of basal cell carcinoma

  1. Dermoscopy
    Detailed examination of suspicious areas of skin using a special magnifying device that allows the structure of the lesion to be assessed.
  2. Laboratory tests
    May be carried out to assess the patient's general health and identify associated conditions.
  3. Consultation with a dermatological surgeon
    This stage is critically important for planning further treatment.

Treatment of basal cell carcinoma

  1. Mohs micrographic surgery
    A highly effective technique for treating basal cell carcinoma that removes as little healthy tissue as possible and reduces the risk of recurrence.
  2. Cryotherapy
    The use of liquid nitrogen to freeze and destroy tumour cells, used for small basal cell carcinomas.
  3. Laser therapy
    May be used to remove superficial tumours without damaging the surrounding tissue.
  4. Photodynamic therapy
    A combination of light and photosensitising agents to destroy cancer cells.
  5. Topical immunotherapy
    The use of creams or ointments containing anti-cancer or immune-modulating agents to treat superficial basal cell carcinomas.

Why patients choose Israel

  • Highly qualified specialists: Israeli dermatologists and oncologists have rich experience in diagnosing and treating every type of skin cancer, basal cell carcinoma included.
  • Modern equipment: Israeli medical institutions are equipped with advanced diagnostic and treatment technology.
  • An individual approach: every patient is offered the treatment that best suits their needs, taking account of the stage of the disease and their general health.
  • Integrated support: patients receive full support at every stage of treatment, from diagnosis through to recovery.

Treatment of basal cell carcinoma in Israel gives patients access to effective and safe therapies, aimed not only at removing the tumour but at preserving quality of life as fully as possible.

fields.title: Blepharoplasty
fields.bodyHtml:
Blepharoplasty is a surgical procedure to correct and reshape the eyelids. It makes the gaze livelier, more open and more expressive, addressing the changes that come with age and various aesthetic concerns. Blepharoplasty is very popular in Israel, where operations are carried out by leading plastic surgeons using the most advanced techniques.

Types and methods of blepharoplasty

Israeli clinics perform the following types of blepharoplasty:

  • Upper eyelid blepharoplasty: removes hooding and drooping of the upper eyelids. During the operation excess fat and skin are removed, and the muscle tissue of the upper eyelid may also be reshaped.
  • Lower eyelid blepharoplasty: addresses puffiness, herniated fat and bags under the eyes. The operation is performed in two ways:
    • Subciliary blepharoplasty: the incision is made along the lash line, allowing the surgeon to remove fat and excess skin.
    • Transconjunctival blepharoplasty: the incision is made on the inner surface of the eyelid, allowing excess fat to be removed or redistributed.
  • Full blepharoplasty: a combined operation performed on the upper and lower eyelids at the same time.
  • Canthopexy: an operation to lift the corners of the eyelids and tighten the supporting ligaments. The procedure lifts the lower eyelid area, corrects the shape and expression of the eyes and removes drooping of the lid.

Indications and recovery

Specialists list the following indications for eyelid blepharoplasty:

  • Hooding of the eyelids
  • Ptosis
  • Drooping of the upper eyelids
  • Asymmetry of the eyes
  • Age-related changes around the eyelids
  • Bags of fat under the eyes
  • Loose skin around the eyes
  • Papillomas
  • Wrinkles around the eyes
  • Keratitis
  • Presbyopia
  • Burn injuries of the eyes

Patients also choose blepharoplasty when they wish to change the shape of the eyes and make the gaze more open and expressive.

The procedure and recovery

Blepharoplasty may be performed for medical or for cosmetic reasons. The innovative technologies used in Israel allow the operation to be carried out as a day case with a minimal recovery period. Depending on the type and extent of the surgery, the operation is performed under local or general anaesthetic.

For a week after the operation patients may have swelling, which gradually subsides. Full recovery takes about two weeks.

Why choose Israel for blepharoplasty?

Israeli specialists in plastic surgery are highly qualified and widely experienced, which allows them to guarantee patients complete safety and excellent aesthetic results. The advantages of choosing Israeli clinics for blepharoplasty:

  • The use of advanced techniques and technologies.
  • A high level of skill and experience among surgeons.
  • A short recovery period.
  • The option of having the operation as a day case.
  • A comprehensive approach to diagnosis and treatment, including consultations and follow-up.

Blepharoplasty in Israel gives good results even in the most difficult cases.

fields.title: Blepharospasm
fields.bodyHtml:
Blepharospasm is a neurological disorder marked by involuntary contractions of the eyelid muscles, which leads to frequent blinking and closing of the eyes. The condition can considerably impair quality of life, causing discomfort and difficulty with everyday activities.

Diagnosis of blepharospasm

  1. Detailed review of the medical history: the doctor talks with the patient, gathering information about symptoms, previous illnesses, treatment and other factors that may affect the condition.
  2. Visual examination: the ophthalmologist examines the patient's eyes and assesses the frequency and intensity of blinking and the state of the eyelid muscles.
  3. Electromyography (EMG): a test that measures the electrical activity of the eyelid muscles and helps identify abnormal muscle contractions.
  4. Neurological examination: carried out to rule out other neurological disorders that may cause similar symptoms.
  5. Ophthalmoscopy: allows the state of the optic nerve, the vessels of the fundus and the retina to be assessed, in order to rule out other possible causes of the symptoms.

Treatment of blepharospasm

  1. Drug therapy:
    • Botulinum toxin (Botox): one of the most effective treatments for blepharospasm. Injections of botulinum toxin into the eyelid muscles temporarily block the nerve impulses causing the spasms, which improves the condition.
    • Anticholinergic drugs: may be used to reduce muscle activity and ease symptoms.
  2. Physiotherapy:
    • Massage and eyelid exercises: help relax the muscles and reduce the frequency of spasms.
    • Warm compresses: help relax the muscles and ease discomfort.
  3. Surgery:
    • Myectomy: an operation to remove part of the eyelid muscle in order to reduce involuntary contractions. Used where other treatments have not worked.
  4. Neurological treatment:
    • Drugs acting on the nervous system: in some cases medicines that act on the central nervous system are prescribed to control symptoms.
  5. Psychological therapy:
    • Consultations with a psychologist or psychotherapist: can help the patient cope with the psychological discomfort and stress associated with blepharospasm.

Advantages of treating blepharospasm in Israel

  1. A high level of medical expertise: Israel has leading specialists in ophthalmology and neurology with many years of experience and exceptional skills.
  2. Modern equipment: clinics are equipped with advanced diagnostic and treatment devices, which allows highly accurate investigation and effective treatment.
  3. An individual approach: every patient is given a personal treatment plan that takes account of the nature of the condition and the patient's general health.
  4. Innovative treatments: the use of the most modern methods and medicines, including botulinum toxin and other innovative therapeutic approaches.
  5. Comfortable conditions: patients can count on a high level of comfort and service during treatment and recovery.

Treatment of blepharospasm in Israel gives patients access to high-quality medical care and considerably improves their quality of life.

fields.title: Heart block
fields.bodyHtml:
Introduction

Heart block is a serious disturbance in the conduction of electrical impulses in the heart, which can slow the heartbeat or stop it altogether. The condition varies in severity and arises from a range of causes. In this article we describe the methods of diagnosis and treatment and the advantages of treating heart block in Israel.

Methods of diagnosis

Heart block may be temporary or permanent, and correct treatment requires the type and degree of block to be established precisely. Modern medicine offers various methods of diagnosing heart block, including:

  • Electrocardiography (ECG): the most widely used and non-invasive method, recording the electrical activity of the heart. An ECG can reveal signs of heart block and determine its type.
  • 24-hour ECG monitoring (Holter monitoring): continuous ECG recording over 24 hours to detect intermittent block or infrequent conduction disturbances.
  • Echocardiography: ultrasound that allows the structure and function of the heart to be assessed, structural causes of block to be identified and the general state of the heart muscle to be evaluated.
  • Electrophysiological study: an invasive method carried out with catheters passed into the heart. It establishes precisely where the block is and what type it is, which allows treatment to be planned more accurately.

Methods of treatment

Treatment of heart block depends on its type and degree and on the patient's general condition. The main treatments include:

  • Drug therapy: doctors may prescribe medicines such as antiarrhythmic drugs or agents that stimulate cardiac conduction, in order to restore a normal heart rhythm.
  • Pacemaker implantation: patients with serious or permanent heart block may need a pacemaker — a device that generates electrical impulses and maintains a normal heart rate.
  • Catheter ablation: a minimally invasive procedure in which abnormal areas of heart tissue are destroyed using catheters passed through the blood vessels.

Advantages of treatment in Israel

Israel is a medical centre of world class, known for its advanced technologies and experienced specialists in cardiology and electrophysiology. The advantages of treating heart block in Israel include:

  • Leading specialists: Israeli cardiologists and electrophysiologists have rich experience and knowledge, which makes treatment highly effective.
  • Use of advanced technology: medical institutions in Israel apply advanced methods of diagnosing and treating heart block, which allows the best results to be achieved.
  • An individual approach to treatment: every patient is offered individual and comprehensive care that takes account of their particular circumstances and needs.

Conclusion

Heart block is a serious disturbance of cardiac conduction that requires accurate diagnosis and appropriate treatment. Modern methods of diagnosis and advanced treatments such as pacemaker implantation or catheter ablation make it possible to deal with heart block successfully and restore normal cardiac function. Israel, as a world leader in cardiology, provides high-quality medical care and has advanced technology for the effective treatment of heart block. If you have problems with your heart, do not delay in consulting a specialist and obtaining qualified help to maintain the health of your heart and your body as a whole.

fields.title: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis
fields.bodyHtml:
Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis: an integrated approach to treatment in Israel

Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS), also known as Lou Gehrig's disease, is a serious progressive disease of the motor neurones that leads to loss of muscle function and, ultimately, to complete paralysis. Israel takes a comprehensive approach to the treatment and support of patients with ALS, aimed at slowing the progression of the disease and improving their quality of life.

Diagnosis of ALS:

  1. Neurological examination: assessment of motor neurone function, muscle strength, reflexes and coordination.
  2. Electromyography (EMG) and nerve conduction studies: to identify abnormalities in the motor neurones.
  3. Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI): to rule out other causes of the symptoms.
  4. Laboratory tests: to rule out other conditions whose symptoms may resemble ALS.

Methods of treating ALS in Israel:

  1. Drug treatment:
    • Drug therapy approved for ALS, which can slow the progression of the disease to a modest degree.
    • Medicines to manage symptoms such as muscle spasms, pain, problems with saliva and breathing difficulties.
  2. Physiotherapy and rehabilitation:
    • Maintaining mobility and preventing joint contractures.
    • Breathing exercises and the use of assisted breathing devices where needed.
  3. Speech and language therapy:
    • Help in preserving the ability to swallow and speak.
    • Training in the use of alternative means of communication as speech is lost.
  4. Psychological support:
    • Counselling for patients and their families to help them adjust to living with the disease.
  5. Nutrition and diet:
    • Dietary advice to prevent weight loss and ensure adequate nutrition.
  6. Use of adaptive devices:
    • Individually chosen aids to ease everyday activity and improve quality of life.

Advantages of treatment in Israel:

  • A multidisciplinary approach: a team of specialists including neurologists, physiotherapists, speech therapists and psychologists works together to provide comprehensive care.
  • Advanced research: Israel takes an active part in international clinical trials of new drugs and treatments for ALS, giving patients access to innovative therapies.
  • Individual care: treatment and support are tailored to each patient's particular needs, taking account of their condition and preferences.

Israel approaches ALS comprehensively, giving patients access to the most advanced treatment and support, which helps them lead fuller lives even with this serious condition.

fields.title: Ankylosing spondylitis
fields.bodyHtml:
Ankylosing spondylitis: modern treatment in Israel — a chronic inflammatory disease of the spine that leads to its gradual fusion and loss of movement. The condition causes pain and stiffness and reduces quality of life. Modern medicine offers various treatments aimed at slowing the progression of the disease and easing symptoms. Israeli clinics provide advanced methods of diagnosis and treatment for ankylosing spondylitis, which allows considerable improvement in patients' condition.

Diagnosis of ankylosing spondylitis in Israel

Ankylosing spondylitis is diagnosed in Israel using modern technology and a comprehensive approach. The main diagnostic methods include:

  • Clinical examination and history: identifying symptoms and reviewing the patient's medical history.
  • Laboratory tests: blood tests to detect markers of inflammation and specific genetic markers such as HLA-B27.
  • X-rays: to identify changes in the spine and joints.
  • Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI): for detailed study of the spine and detection of inflammation at an early stage.
  • Ultrasound examination: to assess the state of the peripheral joints.

Methods of treating ankylosing spondylitis in Israel

Treatment of ankylosing spondylitis aims to reduce inflammation, control pain and improve movement of the spine. The main treatments include:

  • Non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs):
    • Medicines such as ibuprofen and naproxen reduce pain and inflammation.
    • Usually taken for several weeks until symptoms ease.
  • Corticosteroids:
    • Prescribed where NSAIDs are ineffective.
    • May be taken by mouth or injected into the joints.
  • Disease-modifying antirheumatic drugs:
    • Examples: sulfasalazine, methotrexate.
    • Can halt or slow the progression of the disease; intended for long-term use under medical supervision.
  • Biological drugs — TNF blockers:
    • Examples: adalimumab, certolizumab.
    • Prescribed where other drugs have not helped.
    • Given intravenously.
  • Innovative drugs:
    • Golimumab, approved by the FDA in 2017, is also used in Israel.
    • Given by intravenous infusion, with six treatments a year.
    • Clinical trials have shown a considerable reduction in symptoms in most patients.
  • Surgical treatment:
    • Includes joint replacement and operations on the spine.
    • Spinal surgery is considered complex and carries risk.

Advantages of treating ankylosing spondylitis in Israel

  1. Highly qualified specialists: doctors with many years of experience in treating rheumatological disease.
  2. Modern methods of diagnosis and treatment: the use of advanced technology and innovative techniques.
  3. An individual approach: personalised treatment programmes that take account of each patient's circumstances.
  4. A multidisciplinary approach: specialists in narrow fields take part to provide comprehensive treatment.
  5. A high standard of service: comfortable conditions and support for patients at every stage of treatment.

Treatment of ankylosing spondylitis in Israel is aimed at achieving lasting remission, improving quality of life and preventing the disease from progressing. Modern methods of diagnosis and treatment, together with the high professionalism of Israeli doctors, allow patients to achieve considerable improvement and restore movement in the spine.

fields.title: Parkinson's disease
fields.bodyHtml:
Parkinson's disease: advanced treatment in Israel

Parkinson's disease is a progressive neurological condition affecting the motor system. Innovative approaches are used in Israel to treat it, aimed at reducing symptoms and improving patients' quality of life.

Diagnosis of Parkinson's disease:

  1. Neurological examination: assessment of symptoms such as tremor, muscle rigidity, slowness of movement and other characteristic signs.
  2. Medical history: discussion of the history of symptoms and of family history.
  3. Additional tests:
    • MRI of the brain to rule out other conditions.
    • Single-photon emission computed tomography (SPECT) to assess brain function.

Methods of treating Parkinson's disease:

  1. Drug treatment:
    • Medicines that raise dopamine levels (levodopa, for example).
    • MAO-B inhibitors and COMT inhibitors to manage symptoms.
    • Medicines to control non-motor symptoms such as depression and insomnia.
  2. Physical therapy:
    • Exercises to maintain mobility, strength and balance.
    • Specific techniques to make everyday activities easier.
  3. Surgical treatment:
    • Deep brain stimulation (DBS): implantation of electrodes in particular areas of the brain to regulate neurological signals.
  4. Experimental and newest treatments:
    • The use of stem cells to restore damaged nerve cells.
    • New pharmacological research aimed at slowing the progression of the disease.

Advantages of treatment in Israel:

  • An interdisciplinary team of specialists: doctors, neurologists, physiotherapists and others work closely together to create a comprehensive treatment programme.
  • An individual approach: treatment plans are adapted to each patient, taking account of the stage of the disease and their general health.
  • Access to the newest treatments: Israeli clinics take an active part in international clinical trials, giving patients access to advanced therapies.

Treatment of Parkinson's disease in Israel is aimed at achieving the greatest possible control of symptoms and improving patients' quality of life, through advanced medical developments and an individual approach.

fields.title: Crohn's disease
fields.bodyHtml:
Crohn's disease: advanced treatment in Israel

Crohn's disease is a chronic inflammatory condition of the digestive tract that can affect any part from the mouth to the anus, but most often involves the final section of the small intestine and the beginning of the colon. Israeli clinics offer a comprehensive approach to treating the disease, including innovative methods of diagnosis and therapy.

Diagnosis of Crohn's disease:

  1. Colonoscopy with biopsy:
    The main diagnostic method, which allows doctors to see the inner surface of the bowel and take tissue samples for examination.
  2. Capsule endoscopy:
    The patient swallows a small video capsule that transmits thousands of images of the bowel, making it possible to detect inflammation in areas that are hard to reach.
  3. MR and CT enterography:
    High-precision imaging methods used to assess the state of the bowel and the surrounding tissue.
  4. Laboratory tests:
    Full blood count, biochemistry, stool tests and serological tests — checking for antibodies such as ASCA and antineutrophil cytoplasmic antibodies, which can help confirm the diagnosis.

Methods of treating Crohn's disease:

  1. Drug treatment:
    • Anti-inflammatory drugs: such as aminosalicylates and corticosteroids.
    • Immunosuppressants: such as azathioprine, 6-mercaptopurine and methotrexate, to reduce the immune response.
    • Biological drugs: antibodies such as infliximab, adalimumab and vedolizumab, which target specific molecules involved in the inflammatory process.
  2. Nutrition:
    • Specialised diets may be recommended to reduce symptoms and maintain nutritional status.
  3. Surgical treatment:
    • Used where conservative treatment is ineffective, where complications develop (strictures or abscesses, for example) or to remove badly damaged sections of bowel.

Advantages of treatment in Israel:

  • An individual approach to every patient: a personalised treatment plan based on thorough diagnosis and the particular course of the disease.
  • Use of advanced technology: access to the latest pharmaceutical developments and innovative treatments.
  • A multidisciplinary team: gastroenterologists, surgeons, dietitians and other specialists work together to provide comprehensive and effective treatment.

Treatment of Crohn's disease in Israel is aimed at minimising symptoms, improving patients' quality of life and preventing long-term complications, making it possible to lead an active and full life.

fields.title: Coeliac disease
fields.bodyHtml:
Coeliac disease: advanced treatment in Israel

Coeliac disease is an autoimmune condition in which eating gluten damages the lining of the small intestine. Israeli medical centres offer a comprehensive approach to diagnosing and treating coeliac disease, including modern methods of investigation and individual support for patients.

Diagnosis of coeliac disease:

  1. Serological tests
    Measurement of antibodies (tissue transglutaminase IgA, endomysial antibodies), which are often raised in people with coeliac disease.
  2. Genetic tests
    Testing for the HLA-DQ2 and HLA-DQ8 genes, which may indicate a predisposition to coeliac disease.
  3. Endoscopy with biopsy of the small intestine
    The gold standard in diagnosing coeliac disease, allowing the extent of damage to the lining to be assessed.
  4. Capsule endoscopy
    Used to view the whole of the small intestine and identify areas of atrophy that a conventional endoscope cannot reach.

Methods of treating coeliac disease:

  1. A strict gluten-free diet: the only effective treatment for coeliac disease. Excluding all products containing gluten (wheat, rye, barley) allows the lining of the bowel to recover and symptoms to improve.
  2. Support from a dietitian: help in putting together a complete and nutritious gluten-free diet, and training in recognising hidden sources of gluten in food.
  3. Drug treatment: where diet does not lead to full recovery or where complications develop, immunosuppressive drugs may be used to reduce the immune response to gluten.
  4. Regular medical follow-up: monitoring of health and adjustment of the diet where needed, along with checks for possible nutrient deficiencies (iron, vitamin D, B vitamins and others).

Advantages of treatment in Israel:

  • A multidisciplinary approach: gastroenterologists, dietitians, allergy specialists and paediatricians work together to provide comprehensive care.
  • Personalised treatment: an individual treatment and dietary plan drawn up on the basis of each patient's particular needs and condition.
  • Use of the newest technologies: advanced methods of diagnosis and monitoring for accurate assessment of the condition and the effectiveness of treatment.
  • Strong educational support: patients and their families are given access to information about coeliac disease and the gluten-free diet, to help them understand and manage the condition.
  • Comprehensive support at every stage: not only drug treatment and dietary advice but also psychological help in adjusting to changes in daily life.

Treatment of coeliac disease in Israel aims to restore health and quality of life as fully as possible. Thanks to an individual approach and modern medical technology, patients can control their condition effectively and avoid long-term complications.

fields.title: Paediatric oncology
fields.bodyHtml:
Paediatric oncology: advanced treatment in Israel

Paediatric oncology is one of the leading fields in the treatment of cancer in children and adolescents in Israel. Israeli medical centres take a comprehensive approach to the diagnosis, treatment and rehabilitation of young patients, giving them access to innovative therapies and multidisciplinary medical support.

Features of paediatric oncology in Israel

  1. Multidisciplinary teams
    Every case is discussed by a multidisciplinary team including paediatric oncologists, surgeons, radiologists, haematologists and other specialists, in order to draw up the most effective and safest treatment plan.
  2. Advanced methods of diagnosis
    These include MRI, CT, PET-CT, ultrasound, laboratory tests and genetic testing, which allow the condition to be diagnosed accurately and its extent assessed.
  3. Individual treatment
    The use of personalised treatments, including chemotherapy, radiotherapy, targeted therapy, immunotherapy and surgery, taking account of the particular features of the disease and the patient.
  4. Support and rehabilitation
    Comprehensive support for children and their families, including psychological help, rehabilitation programmes and advice on nutrition and daily life.

Treatment of common childhood cancers

  • Leukaemia
    Combined programmes of chemotherapy and targeted therapy are used, with bone marrow transplantation where necessary.
  • Lymphoma
    Treatment includes chemotherapy, immunotherapy and radiotherapy, adapted to the particular type of lymphoma.
  • Neuroblastoma
    Combined treatment including chemotherapy, surgery, radiotherapy and, in some cases, immunotherapy.
  • Glioma and other brain tumours
    Individually chosen treatment that may include surgery, radiotherapy and chemotherapy.
  • Osteosarcoma and other sarcomas
    Treatment usually begins with neoadjuvant chemotherapy, followed by surgical removal of the tumour and adjuvant chemotherapy.

Why patients choose Israel for paediatric cancer care

  • A high level of medical expertise
    Israeli doctors are known for their high professionalism and their treatment outcomes.
  • Access to the newest drugs and technologies
    Israel takes an active part in international clinical trials, giving patients access to the newest treatments.
  • A child-centred approach
    Every aspect of treatment is adapted to children's needs, creating a supportive and caring environment.
  • Integrated support for the family
    Help for families in coping with the emotional, social and financial difficulties that treatment brings.

Paediatric cancer care in Israel offers young patients and their families hope and access to advanced medical resources, helping achieve the best possible outcomes and a return to a full life after illness.

fields.title: Oesophageal diverticulum
fields.bodyHtml:
Oesophageal diverticulum: advanced treatment in Israel

An oesophageal diverticulum is a pouch-like protrusion of the wall of the oesophagus that can lead to difficulty swallowing, chest pain and aspiration of food. Modern methods of diagnosing and treating this condition are available in Israel, aimed at relieving symptoms and preventing complications.

Diagnosis of oesophageal diverticulum:

  1. Barium swallow X-ray:
    The most widely used diagnostic method, allowing the shape and size of the diverticulum to be seen.
  2. Upper gastrointestinal endoscopy:
    Allows the diverticulum and the lining of the oesophagus to be examined directly.
  3. Oesophageal manometry:
    A test that assesses pressure and movement in the oesophagus, which helps establish why the diverticulum has formed.

Methods of treating oesophageal diverticulum:

  1. Conservative treatment:
    • Changes in diet: avoiding large pieces of solid food and eating small portions can help minimise symptoms.
    • Rinsing the oesophagus: rinsing with water regularly after meals to prevent food becoming trapped in the diverticulum.
  2. Endoscopic treatment:
    • Flexible endoscopic myotomy (Zenker's diverticulum): a modern treatment in which an incision is made through the endoscope in the muscle causing the diverticulum to form. This reduces pressure and helps the diverticulum shrink.
  3. Surgical treatment:
    • Endoscopic myotomy: a minimally invasive procedure carried out through an endoscope. It involves dividing the muscle that causes the diverticulum to form, which reduces pressure and eases symptoms. The method reduces risk and shortens recovery compared with traditional surgery.

Advantages of treatment in Israel:

  • An individual approach: treatment is chosen according to the size of the diverticulum, the symptoms and the patient's general health.
  • Access to the newest technologies: the use of the latest advances in endoscopy and surgery for minimally invasive treatment.
  • Highly qualified medical specialists: leading gastroenterologists and surgeons with international experience.
  • Comprehensive medical support: the full range of care is provided, from diagnosis through to recovery after treatment.

Treatment of oesophageal diverticulum in Israel is aimed at reducing symptoms as far as possible and preventing complications. With advanced methods of diagnosis and treatment, patients can achieve a considerable improvement in quality of life and avoid further medical problems associated with the condition.

fields.title: Endocarditis
fields.bodyHtml:
Endocarditis (infective and non-infective): advanced treatment in Israel

Endocarditis is a serious inflammatory condition of the inner lining of the heart, including the heart valves. Modern approaches to its diagnosis and treatment are used in Israel, aimed at eliminating the infection, restoring the function of the heart valves and preventing complications.

Diagnosis of endocarditis:

  1. Clinical examination: the doctor assesses symptoms such as fever, fatigue, joint pain, new heart murmurs and other signs that may point to inflammation.
  2. Echocardiography: the main diagnostic method, allowing the structure of the heart valves to be seen and signs of infection detected.
  3. Blood cultures: tests to identify the organism causing the infection, which is critically important in choosing antibiotic treatment.
  4. Additional investigations may include CT and MRI of the chest, along with other laboratory tests to assess general health and detect complications.

Methods of treating endocarditis in Israel:

  1. Drug therapy: intensive intravenous treatment with modern medicines chosen on the basis of blood culture results is the foundation of treatment for endocarditis.
  2. Surgical treatment: in some cases, particularly where serious complications develop or antibiotic treatment is ineffective, surgery may be needed to replace or repair the affected heart valves.
  3. Supportive treatment: may include medicines to support the work of the heart, correction of electrolyte imbalances and other measures to stabilise the patient's condition.

Advantages of treatment in Israel:

  • An interdisciplinary team: cardiologists, infectious disease specialists, cardiac surgeons and others work closely together to develop and carry out an individual treatment plan for each patient.
  • Advanced medical technology: the use of modern diagnostic and surgical equipment improves the accuracy of diagnosis and the effectiveness of treatment.
  • An individual approach to treatment: treatment programmes are adapted to each patient's needs, which produces the best results and minimises the risk of complications.
  • Innovative treatments: the continuous introduction of the newest treatments and antibiotic regimens to fight the infection.

Treatment of endocarditis in Israel is aimed at eliminating the infection quickly, restoring the function of the heart and preventing further complications, which gives patients the best chance of full recovery and a return to an active life.

fields.title: Endometriosis
fields.bodyHtml:
Endometriosis: innovative treatment in Israel

Endometriosis is a condition in which tissue resembling the lining of the uterus (the endometrium) grows outside it. In Israel, patients can count on a comprehensive approach to diagnosing and treating endometriosis, including the latest research and individual treatment programmes.

Diagnosis of endometriosis

  1. Gynaecological examination
    Helps identify possible areas of endometriosis and assess the general state of the reproductive organs.
  2. Ultrasound examination
    Used to visualise endometriotic lesions in the ovaries and other parts of the pelvis.
  3. Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI)
    Produces detailed images and is particularly useful in diagnosing deeply infiltrating endometriosis.
  4. Laparoscopy
    The gold standard in diagnosing endometriosis, allowing the pelvic cavity to be examined directly and tissue samples taken for histological examination.
  5. Laboratory tests
    Blood tests may be ordered to detect markers of inflammation and any specific biomarkers of endometriosis. Although there is no blood test unique to endometriosis, such tests can help assess general health and identify associated problems.

Methods of treating endometriosis in Israel

  1. Drug treatment
    Includes the use of hormonal medicines to manage the symptoms of endometriosis and slow its progression.
  2. Surgical treatment
    Laparoscopic removal of endometriotic lesions, scarring and adhesions helps reduce pain and restore fertility.
  3. Innovative treatments
    Including targeted therapy and immune-modulating therapy, directed at the underlying mechanisms by which endometriosis develops.
  4. Fertility support
    Consultations and assisted reproduction for women who wish to become mothers.

Advantages of treatment in Israel

  • A multidisciplinary approach: specialists from various fields of medicine work together to develop the best treatment plan.
  • Personalised treatment: every treatment is chosen individually, taking account of each patient's particular needs.
  • Access to the newest technologies: Israeli clinics use the latest advances in medicine to treat endometriosis effectively.
  • Comprehensive support: patients receive full care, including psychological support and rehabilitation programmes.

Treatment of endometriosis in Israel offers women not only advanced therapies but also the hope of an improved quality of life and the chance to fulfil their plans for a family.

fields.title: Knee replacement
fields.bodyHtml:
Knee replacement: innovative treatment in Israel

Knee replacement is a modern surgical treatment used for serious damage and disease of the knee joint, such as osteoarthritis. In Israel this operation is performed using advanced technologies and materials, which ensures good recovery of joint function and an improved quality of life for patients.

Investigations before knee replacement:

  1. X-ray: allows the extent of joint damage and degenerative change to be assessed.
  2. Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI): used for detailed assessment of the soft tissues, cartilage and bones of the knee joint.
  3. Computed tomography (CT): may be recommended for more precise imaging of the bony structures.
  4. Laboratory tests: full blood count, biochemistry and tests for markers of inflammation, to assess general health and identify any reasons why surgery should not go ahead.

How knee replacement is carried out in Israel:

  1. Minimally invasive replacement
    The joint component is implanted through small incisions, which reduces injury and speeds recovery.
  2. Total replacement
    Complete surgical removal of the damaged tissue and its replacement with a prosthesis that reproduces the natural movement of the knee.
  3. Partial replacement
    Suitable where only part of the cartilage is damaged.
  4. Bilateral replacement
    Replacement of both sides at once, preferable for patients in whom both knees are affected.

Advantages of treatment in Israel:

  • Advanced technology: the use of modern prostheses and minimally invasive surgical techniques.
  • Highly qualified specialists: experienced surgeons and rehabilitation specialists who focus on joint disease and injury.
  • An individual approach: a personalised programme of treatment and rehabilitation for every patient.
  • A comprehensive approach to recovery: an extensive rehabilitation programme aimed at restoring knee function quickly and improving quality of life.

Knee replacement in Israel gives patients access to the best international practice, with a high rate of successful outcomes and a minimal risk of complications.

fields.title: Endoscopic discectomy
fields.bodyHtml:
Endoscopic discectomy is a minimally invasive surgical procedure designed to relieve back pain caused by a herniated disc. It is well suited to patients whose pain has not been eased by conservative treatment such as medication or physiotherapy.

Key features of the procedure:

  1. Minimal injury: the procedure is carried out through a small incision using specialised endoscopic equipment, which minimises pain after surgery and speeds recovery.
  2. Precisely targeted intervention: the endoscope allows the surgeon to remove only the affected part of the disc accurately and carefully, leaving healthy tissue and the structures of the spine intact.
  3. No metal implants: the procedure uses no metal implants or constructions, which spares patients the complications that can go with them.
  4. Rapid recovery: the hospital stay after the procedure is just one day, and full recovery usually takes up to a week — considerably faster than with traditional surgery.
  5. High effectiveness: endoscopic discectomy produces excellent results in relieving pain and improving mobility and quality of life.

The procedure is recommended for patients diagnosed with a herniated disc who have severe pain and other symptoms that have not responded to standard treatment.

fields.title: Facelift: facial rejuvenation
fields.bodyHtml:
What is a facelift?

A facelift is a surgical procedure to tighten the skin and reshape the contours of the face. It is one of the most popular operations in plastic surgery, particularly among patients over 40. In Israel the procedure is carried out by leading plastic surgeons using the most modern and innovative techniques, which guarantees safety and a high-quality result.

Types of facelift

  1. Full facelift: a comprehensive operation covering the forehead, cheeks, chin and neck.
  2. Mini facelift: a minimally invasive procedure aimed at correcting particular areas of the face.
  3. SMAS lift: lifting of the superficial musculoaponeurotic system to improve the contours of the face and neck.
  4. Contouring with fillers: the use of fillers to restore volume and smooth wrinkles.
  5. Biorevitalisation: injectable treatments for deep hydration and rejuvenation of the skin.
  6. Thread lift: lifting of the skin with special threads that stimulate the collagen framework.

Indications

A facelift is recommended in the following cases:

  • Wrinkles and folds in the skin of the face.
  • Sagging and loss of skin tone.
  • Fat deposits around the chin and neck.
  • Drooping of the tissues (ptosis).
  • Pronounced nasolabial folds.
  • Drooping of the upper eyelids and brows.
  • Changes in the contours of the face with age.

How the facelift procedure is carried out

The procedure is performed under local anaesthetic and takes about an hour and a half to two hours. The surgeon makes small incisions around the ears, through which excess fat and skin are removed. New facial contours are then formed and the muscles tightened. At the end of the operation a bandage is applied to the face and drainage tubes are fitted to allow fluid to escape.

Recovery after a facelift

After the procedure the patient remains under the care of specialists at the clinic. The dressings and drainage tubes are removed after two days, and if there are no complications the patient goes home. Full recovery takes about two weeks, during which physical activity and the use of cosmetics should be avoided. The results of the operation appear over several weeks and last for many years.

Why choose Israel for a facelift?

Israeli clinics and specialists are known for their high professionalism and their use of advanced techniques. The advantages of having a facelift in Israel include:

  • Highly qualified and experienced surgeons.
  • The use of the most modern technologies and innovative methods.
  • An individual approach to every patient.
  • Minimal risk and a high level of safety.
  • Comfortable conditions for recovery and follow-up.

A facelift in Israel is a chance to restore youth and beauty to your face with the assurance of good results and safety.

fields.title: Gastritis
fields.bodyHtml:
Gastritis: advanced treatment in Israel

Gastritis is inflammation of the lining of the stomach, which can be caused by various factors including infection, stress, alcohol, certain medicines and autoimmune processes. Modern approaches to diagnosis and treatment are available in Israel, aimed at removing the causes of gastritis and easing its symptoms.

Diagnosis of gastritis:

  1. Endoscopy: allows the doctor to examine the lining of the stomach and take tissue samples for biopsy, which is necessary to determine the type of inflammation and the presence of infections such as Helicobacter pylori.
  2. Tests for Helicobacter pylori:
    • Urea breath test: a non-invasive method of detecting H. pylori.
    • Blood, stool or biopsy tests: looking for antibodies or genetic markers of the bacterium.
  3. Barium X-ray of the stomach: may be used to assess structural changes in the stomach and how it functions.

Methods of treating gastritis:

  1. Drug treatment:
    • Antacids and proton pump inhibitors: to reduce the acidity of the stomach contents and protect the lining.
    • Antibiotics: where H. pylori infection is found, to eradicate it.
    • Medicines that protect the lining: such as sucralfate, which help inflamed areas to heal.
  2. Diet and lifestyle changes:
    • Dietary advice: avoiding spicy and fatty food and alcohol. Eating small portions is recommended.
    • Giving up smoking and reducing stress: since these factors can make the symptoms of gastritis worse.
  3. Supportive treatment:
    • Probiotics: may be recommended to maintain a healthy gut flora and improve digestion.

Advantages of treatment in Israel:

  • A multidisciplinary approach: gastroenterologists, dietitians and psychologists work together to provide comprehensive care.
  • Use of advanced technology: access to the newest methods of diagnosis and treatment, which improves the effectiveness of therapy.
  • Individual treatment: treatment plans drawn up with each patient's particular circumstances and needs in mind.

Treatment of gastritis in Israel is aimed at removing the causes of the condition and easing its symptoms, which helps patients restore and maintain their health and quality of life.

fields.title: Gastro-oesophageal reflux disease (GORD)
fields.bodyHtml:
Gastro-oesophageal reflux disease (GORD): advanced treatment in Israel

Gastro-oesophageal reflux disease is a chronic condition in which the contents of the stomach regularly return into the oesophagus, causing heartburn and discomfort. Modern approaches to diagnosing and treating GORD are available in Israel, aimed at reducing symptoms and improving patients' quality of life.

Diagnosis of GORD:

  1. Endoscopy:
    Allows the doctor to examine the lining of the oesophagus and stomach for damage or inflammation.
  2. Oesophageal pH monitoring:
    24-hour monitoring of pH in the oesophagus to assess how often and for how long acid reflux occurs.
  3. Oesophageal manometry:
    Assessment of the motor function of the oesophagus and the work of the lower oesophageal sphincter.
  4. Barium X-ray of the oesophagus and stomach:
    Used to image the anatomy of the oesophagus and identify abnormalities that contribute to reflux.

Methods of treating GORD:

  1. Conservative treatment:
    • Lifestyle changes: raising the head of the bed, avoiding late meals and avoiding foods that trigger reflux (fatty and spicy food, caffeine, alcohol).
    • Drug therapy: the use of proton pump inhibitors and antacids to reduce the acidity of the stomach contents and protect the lining of the oesophagus.
  2. Surgical treatment:
    • Nissen fundoplication: an operation in which the upper part of the stomach is wrapped around the lower part of the oesophagus to strengthen its sphincter and prevent reflux.
    • Minimally invasive methods, such as transoral incisionless fundoplication (TIF) and the LINX magnetic device fitted around the oesophagus.

Advantages of treatment in Israel:

  • An individual approach: treatment is chosen according to the severity of symptoms, the patient's way of life and the response to initial treatment.
  • Interdisciplinary medical teams: gastroenterologists, surgeons and dietitians work together to provide comprehensive care.
  • Access to the newest technologies and medicines: the use of modern methods of diagnosis and treatment, including advanced surgical techniques and pharmaceuticals.

Treatment of GORD in Israel is aimed at achieving lasting remission, preventing complications and improving patients' quality of life through a comprehensive and individually chosen approach.

fields.title: Haemangioma
fields.bodyHtml:
Haemangioma: advanced treatment in Israel

A haemangioma is a benign tumour arising from blood vessels. It is most often seen in children as a mark on the skin, but it can also appear in adults and affect the internal organs. In Israel, patients with a haemangioma are offered a comprehensive approach to diagnosis and treatment, including modern methods of assessment and individual treatment strategies.

Diagnosis of haemangioma

  1. Physical examination and history
    The doctor assesses the nature and position of the growth and gathers information about how it has grown and any symptoms.
  2. Ultrasound examination
    Helps assess the structure, size and depth of the growth and its relationship to the surrounding tissue.
  3. MRI or CT
    Used for detailed imaging of haemangiomas located in deeper tissue or in the internal organs.
  4. Biopsy
    Rarely needed, and only where it is necessary to rule out a malignant growth.
    (histology brought from elsewhere can also be reviewed)

Treatment of haemangioma

  1. Observation
    Many haemangiomas in children shrink on their own, so where there are no symptoms observation may be recommended.
  2. Drug treatment
    Propranolol and other beta blockers are used successfully to reduce the size of a haemangioma.
  3. Laser therapy
    Effective for superficial haemangiomas, reducing their size and improving their appearance.
  4. Surgery
    Recommended where the haemangioma causes functional problems, pain or cosmetic concerns.
  5. Sclerotherapy
    Injection of an agent into the growth that causes it to scar and shrink.

Why patients choose Israel

  • Highly qualified specialists
    Israel has doctors of international standing with extensive experience in diagnosing and treating haemangiomas.
  • An individual approach
    Every patient is given a personalised treatment plan that takes account of all aspects of their health and the particular features of the growth.
  • Advanced technology
    The use of modern equipment and innovative treatments ensures effectiveness and minimal risk.
  • A comprehensive approach
    Israel gives close attention not only to treating the growth but to supporting patients, including rehabilitation and psychological help.

Treatment of haemangioma in Israel gives patients access to high-quality medical care, modern treatments and comprehensive support at every stage of therapy, which helps them recover quickly and improves their quality of life.

fields.title: Haemorrhoids
fields.bodyHtml:
Haemorrhoids: advanced treatment in Israel

Haemorrhoids are a condition in which the veins around the rectum and anus become inflamed and swollen, leading to pain, bleeding and discomfort. Israeli clinics offer a comprehensive approach to treating haemorrhoids, using modern medical technologies and methods to minimise discomfort and improve patients' quality of life.

Diagnosis of haemorrhoids:

  1. Proctological examination:
    Includes visual examination and palpation of the anal area to assess the state of the veins.
  2. Anoscopy:
    The use of an anoscope for detailed examination of the inside of the anal canal and rectum.
  3. Colonoscopy:
    May be recommended to rule out other conditions of the colon and rectum, particularly where there is bleeding.

Methods of treating haemorrhoids:

  1. Conservative treatment:
    • Drug therapy: the use of local anaesthetics, venotonic agents, anti-inflammatory preparations and treatments that promote healing.
    • Lifestyle changes: a high-fibre diet to make bowel movements easier, increased fluid intake and regular exercise.
  2. Minimally invasive procedures:
    • Sclerotherapy: injection of a sclerosing agent into the haemorrhoid to shrink it.
    • Infrared coagulation: the use of infrared light to cauterise and shrink haemorrhoids.
    • Rubber band ligation: placing bands around the base of the haemorrhoid so that it withers and falls away.
  3. Surgical treatment:
    • Haemorrhoidectomy: surgical removal of the haemorrhoids; used in difficult cases or where other methods have not worked.
    • Transanal haemorrhoidal dearterialisation: a newer procedure in which the blood supply to the haemorrhoids is blocked, causing them to shrink.

Advantages of treatment in Israel:

  • A personalised approach: treatment is chosen individually for each patient according to the stage of the condition and the symptoms.
  • Use of advanced treatments: innovative procedures and technologies make treatment highly effective and keep the risk of complications to a minimum.
  • Comprehensive follow-up after surgery: patients receive advice on diet, lifestyle and managing symptoms to prevent recurrence.

Treatment of haemorrhoids in Israel is aimed at improving patients' condition quickly and removing the underlying causes, which allows lasting remission and a better quality of life.

fields.title: Hydronephrosis
fields.bodyHtml:
Introduction

Hydronephrosis is a serious kidney condition marked by swelling of the renal calyces and pelvis, caused by an obstruction to the flow of urine. It can arise from blockage of the ureters, stones, tumours, congenital abnormalities or other problems that prevent urine draining normally from the kidney. If hydronephrosis is not detected and treated in good time, it can lead to serious consequences, including deterioration of kidney function and the development of chronic renal failure.

Methods of diagnosis

Diagnosing hydronephrosis is an important step in ensuring effective treatment. Several methods allow doctors to establish the presence and degree of hydronephrosis precisely:

  • Ultrasound of the kidneys: one of the most accessible and safest ways of diagnosing hydronephrosis. Ultrasound allows doctors to see the structures of the kidney and establish whether the renal calyces and pelvis are dilated.
  • Computed tomography (CT): CT scanning produces more detailed and precise images of the kidneys and urinary tract. It is particularly useful for establishing the cause of hydronephrosis, such as stones, tumours or congenital abnormalities.
  • Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI): may be used for further study of the kidney structures and to obtain detailed images without radiation.
  • Urography: an X-ray method in which a contrast medium is introduced into the urinary tract to identify obstruction of the ureter and establish the degree of hydronephrosis.

Methods of treatment

Treatment of hydronephrosis depends directly on its cause and severity. In some cases, where the obstruction is minor, it may resolve on its own. Whenever hydronephrosis is diagnosed, however, a qualified medical specialist should always be consulted to determine the best approach to treatment. The main treatments are as follows:

  • Drug treatment: in some cases hydronephrosis is caused by inflammation or infection. Antibiotics or anti-inflammatory medicines may then be prescribed to remove the cause.
  • Widening the ureter: where the ureter is narrowed, an intervention may be carried out to widen the path for urine to drain.
  • Removal of stones and tumours: where stones or tumours are the cause of hydronephrosis, surgery may be needed to remove the obstruction.
  • Drainage of the renal calyces and pelvis: in some cases doctors may fit a temporary drain to ease the flow of urine and reduce pressure in the kidneys.

Advantages of treatment in Israel

Israel is known for its advanced medical equipment, its high level of technology and its experienced specialists. Treating hydronephrosis in Israel offers a number of advantages:

  • Medical innovation: Israel takes an active part in medical research and development. The most modern methods of diagnosing and treating hydronephrosis are available here.
  • An interdisciplinary approach: doctors in Israel often work across disciplines, which supports comprehensive care for patients with hydronephrosis. Clinical teams bring together urologists, nephrologists, surgeons and other specialists to provide the best possible treatment and care.
  • Experienced specialists: doctors at Israeli medical centres have high professionalism and many years of experience in treating hydronephrosis and other conditions of the kidneys and urinary tract. They are trained at leading medical institutions and continually develop their skills and knowledge.
  • Infrastructure and equipment: medical centres in Israel are equipped with advanced technology for accurate diagnosis and innovative treatment. This improves outcomes and reduces the risk of complications.
  • An individual approach: doctors in Israel aim to treat every patient individually. They take account of the particular features of the condition, the patient's general health and their personal needs in drawing up the best treatment plan.
  • Support at every stage: Israeli medical centres provide comprehensive support to patients throughout treatment. Coordinators help with travel arrangements and interpreting and provide the information patients and their families need.

Conclusion

Hydronephrosis is a serious kidney condition that requires timely diagnosis and treatment. With modern methods of diagnosis and advanced treatment, patients have an excellent chance of overcoming it. Israel, with its advanced medical infrastructure and experienced specialists, offers high-quality treatment for hydronephrosis, giving patients the best chance of restoring their health and quality of life.

If you suspect hydronephrosis or have other kidney problems, it is important to seek medical help as soon as possible. Remember that early detection and treatment lead to better results and prevent possible complications.

fields.title: Hypertension
fields.bodyHtml:
Hypertension: a balanced approach to controlling blood pressure

Introduction

Hypertension, or raised blood pressure, is one of the most common cardiovascular conditions and affects millions of people worldwide. High blood pressure can bring serious complications such as stroke, heart attack and damage to the organs. Timely diagnosis and effective treatment are essential to controlling it. In this article we describe the methods of diagnosis and treatment and the advantages of treating hypertension in Israel.

Methods of diagnosis

Accurate diagnosis of hypertension plays a decisive part in choosing a treatment strategy. Modern medicine offers a range of diagnostic methods, including:

  • Blood pressure measurement: the simplest and most accessible way of diagnosing hypertension. Raised pressure is usually identified through repeated measurements at different times.
  • 24-hour blood pressure monitoring: continuous recording of blood pressure over 24 hours for a more accurate assessment of how it changes at different times of day.
  • Laboratory tests: measurement of cholesterol, glucose, creatinine and other markers helps assess the risk of complications and determine a suitable treatment plan.

Methods of treatment

Treatment of hypertension aims to lower blood pressure and prevent complications. It may include:

  • Lifestyle changes: changes to diet, more physical activity and giving up smoking help lower blood pressure and improve general health.
  • Drug therapy: doctors may prescribe antihypertensive medicines to control blood pressure and reduce the risk of complications.
  • Nerve blocks: an innovative treatment that involves blocking the sympathetic nerves that control blood pressure.
  • Renal revascularisation: in some cases, where hypertension is linked to narrowing of the renal arteries, a revascularisation procedure may be needed to restore normal blood flow.

Advantages of treatment in Israel

Israel is a medical centre of world class, where doctors use advanced technologies and innovative treatments for hypertension. The advantages of treating hypertension in Israel include:

  • Qualified specialists: Israeli cardiologists and vascular surgeons have a high level of knowledge and experience in treating hypertension.
  • An integrated approach: Israel takes a whole-person approach to treating hypertension, combining drug therapy with changes in lifestyle.
  • Research and development: medical institutions in Israel take an active part in research into new treatments for hypertension, which gives access to advanced technologies and procedures.

Conclusion

Hypertension is a serious condition that requires timely diagnosis and appropriate treatment. Modern methods of diagnosis and the range of available treatments make it possible to control blood pressure and prevent complications. Israel, as a medical centre of world class, provides high-quality treatment for hypertension through advanced technology and an individual approach to every patient. If you have problems with your blood pressure, you should consult a specialist and take steps to control it and protect the health of your heart and circulation.

fields.title: High blood pressure
fields.bodyHtml:
High blood pressure: advanced treatment in Israel

Hypertension, or raised blood pressure, is an important risk factor for cardiovascular disease. Israel takes a comprehensive approach to diagnosing and treating hypertension, combining drug and non-drug strategies to manage the condition.

Diagnosis of hypertension:

  1. Blood pressure measurement
    Regular monitoring of blood pressure to assess its level and fluctuations.
  2. Laboratory tests
    Blood and urine tests to identify possible causes of raised pressure and to assess the kidneys, heart and endocrine system.
  3. Electrocardiogram (ECG)
    To identify possible changes in the work of the heart caused by long-standing raised pressure.
  4. Echocardiography
    Ultrasound examination to assess the structure and function of the heart, including the thickness of the walls and the state of the valves.

Methods of treating hypertension:

  1. Drug treatment:
    • Antihypertensive medicines: including ACE inhibitors, angiotensin II receptor blockers, diuretics, beta blockers and calcium channel blockers.
    • Statins and other medicines to control cholesterol where needed.
  2. Lifestyle changes:
    • A diet low in sodium and rich in potassium.
    • Regular moderate exercise.
    • Weight loss where there is obesity.
    • Giving up smoking and moderating alcohol intake.
  3. Education and support for patients:
    • Programmes to raise patients' awareness of the importance of controlling blood pressure and following medical advice.

Advantages of treatment in Israel:

  • A multidisciplinary approach: cardiologists, endocrinologists, dietitians and other specialists work together to manage the condition as well as possible.
  • Personalised treatment: an individual treatment plan drawn up after a thorough assessment of the patient's health.
  • Innovative treatments: the latest advances in medicine are applied to control hypertension effectively.
  • A high standard of medical care: the use of modern technology and equipment for accurate diagnosis and treatment.

fields.title: Hypospadias
fields.bodyHtml:
Introduction

Hypospadias is a congenital abnormality in boys in which the opening of the urethra lies below its normal position on the head of the penis. It is a serious condition that can considerably affect quality of life and the ability to lead a normal sexual life. In this article we look at the methods of diagnosing and treating hypospadias and the advantages of having it treated in Israel.

Methods of diagnosis
